title: AI Assisted Report Drafting Foundation
goal: Let operators draft report narrative faster while preserving evidence-backed review and export truth.
scope: Implement an operator-reviewed AI draft path for selected report sections using existing findings, inventory, methodology tags, evidence references, and client context. Drafts must be clearly marked and never replace canonical evidence or report provenance.
generation_reason: Product recommendation coverage audit found AI-assisted report writing was deferred but not queued as its own package.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Draft narrative only. Do not alter evidence, canonical findings, methodology mappings, or generated report facts without operator review.
notes: AI drafts must cite source data categories or evidence references.
Provider-disabled and provider-failure behavior must be deterministic.

success_criteria: Report Center can generate an operator-reviewed draft for selected sections when AI is enabled.
Draft text is visibly marked as AI-assisted and traceable to existing evidence.
Provider disabled/failure states leave normal reports unchanged.
Tests cover draft generation, fallback behavior, and no canonical data mutation.
Docs explain review responsibility and evidence boundaries.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: AI report drafting is optional and operator-reviewed.
Canonical report facts and evidence remain unchanged by draft generation.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
Allowed draft sections and review language are documented.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with report-drafting changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the AI report-drafting baseline and remaining review limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
